scope: post hoc; Referee 1 point 3 and Referee 2 point 2
limits: an algorithmic reconstruction of the documented rule, not a reader study; for non-Philips participants the arrays are already the archive's published DCE crop, so parts B and C test the support within that crop and not the crop itself; OMIT regions and the specification's neighbour operation are not reconstructed

containment.statement: every voxel of the supplied support is tested against percent enhancement computed from the precontrast and early images only, at the threshold the archive stored for that examination

automatic_redraw.statement: the box is found from orthogonal projections with no reader input; the largest bright component is kept, which is the contralateral breast whenever that side enhances more

F1_the_supplied_support_is_an_early_only.statement: at its worst examination the supplied support is 0.983 early-only selectable

F2_an_interval_excluding_zero_in_the_reb.statement: at no margin does the AUC difference have an interval that excludes zero

F3_empty_support_share.statement: the rule produces a support for all but 0.0% of examinations at the worst margin

F4_median_dice.statement: the rebuilt and supplied supports overlap at a median Dice of 0.972 at the best margin
